description: The supplied six-strand braid lifts to a positive genus-two identity factorization with six nonseparating and seven separating twists. A section of this specific fibration has not yet been verified.

sections.Surface and conventions: The six-point sphere has a double cover branched at the marked points, giving a closed genus-two fiber. Half twists lift to nonseparating Dehn twists; squared twists around three points lift to separating Dehn twists. The sphere identity and +I homology action exclude the hyperelliptic involution, establishing identity on the closed genus-two fiber. Section framing remains open.
sections.Derivation: A certificate records 2,486 elementary rewrites, including 19 sphere-relator substitutions. A portable verifier checks every move.
sections.Braid factorization: The source is the 178-letter word transcribed from the supplied BraidSixSeven.svg; its exact source-file SHA-256 is recorded in the proof.
sections.Planar mapping class diagrams: The local interactive lab displays thirteen factors and exact support-class checks. Correspondence with every drawing in the supplied PDF remains provisional.
sections.Standard mapping classes: The final word is a positive full twist on punctures 4,5,6 followed by a negative full twist on punctures 1,2,3. The two curves are complementary on the sphere, so the Dehn twists cancel.
sections.Equivalences and transformations: The disk braid action is nontrivial. On the sphere the outer action is trivial, while the spherical braid represents its nontrivial central full twist. The full braid-relations proof establishes the sphere mapping-class identity; the five-chain homology calculation distinguishes the identity from the genus-two deck involution.
sections.Sections and multisections: The branch points form three two-element monodromy orbits: (1,4), (2,5), and (3,6). These suggest degree-two multisections, not sections from fixed Weierstrass points. Xiao's degree-four (6,7) fibration is known to admit a smooth section, but equivalence with this supplied factorization and its section self-intersection remain unproved.
sections.References: User-supplied braid SVG; Birman-Hilden genus-two lifting theory; Zoltán Szabó, arXiv:2609.34042 (Xiao comparison). The supplied factorization has not been identified with that publication.
